name: TagInput
description: A text field that turns what you type into removable tags when you press Enter or comma: for keywords, recipients and labels.

label.description: Visible label, also the accessible name.

description.description: Help text, e.g. "Press Enter or comma to add".

errorMessage.description: Shown when the field is invalid.

onChange.description: Called with the full list whenever it changes.

placeholder.description: Hint shown while there are no tags.

maxTags.description: Most tags allowed. The input is disabled once reached.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the field.

keyboard: Type, then Enter or comma to add a tag; pasting a comma-separated list adds each
Backspace in an empty input removes the last tag
Left arrow from the start of the input moves into the tags; arrows move between tags
Delete or Backspace on a focused tag removes it, and focus moves to a neighbour
requirements: The group is named by the label; tags are a list, each with a Remove button named after it
Every add and remove is announced in a live region, e.g. "design added, 3 tags"
Duplicates and the maximum are explained in text when refused
The input keeps its own accessible name and description
screenReader: The input is announced with the label and description, and how many tags there are
Adding announces the tag and the new count; removing announces what was removed
Refusing a duplicate or hitting the limit is announced with the reason

use_when: Free-form keywords, labels and email recipients
Lists the person builds by typing
avoid_when: Choosing from a fixed list: use Combobox or checkboxes
anti_patterns: No visible way to remove a tag with a mouse
Needing a comma to submit the last tag with no Enter
